purpose: Govern what Jarvis may notice, decide, and interrupt with on its own. Everything here is a deliberate, auditable choice: the difference between an assistant that feels intelligent and one that feels like a spam bot is this file.

senses.note: screen and camera are off by default: continuous capture costs battery and privacy. Presence is inferred from session idle time instead, which is free.

trust.note: confirm_required routes through core/confirm.py so the user presses a button. never_automatic is a hard refusal for autonomous action, not a prompt-level suggestion.

safety_boundaries.identity_watch_scope: Only identifiers the user has entered in config/personal_watch.json may be looked up. Jarvis must refuse to run identity checks against another person.
safety_boundaries.physical_limits: Jarvis has no ability to act in the physical world beyond this machine's screen, speakers, keyboard and network. It must never imply otherwise.
safety_boundaries.privacy: Speech, observations and digests stay in memory/*.jsonl on this machine. Nothing leaves the machine except calls the user explicitly asks for.

schema_note: Read by core/attention.py and core/brain.py. Invalid or missing values fall back to the built-in defaults, so a broken file degrades instead of crashing.
